replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Sorry, but your map has been denied and will not appear in the Avicus Network repository/rotations. The reason(s) your map has been denied:

- Too much "randomness". As this implies, the map shows that there's too much randomness in the terrain (switching from modern style to forest style throughout the map). 

- Somewhat low aesthetics quality. The map seems like there's not enough "detail" in structures, and other parts show blocky pathways. Try to add more designs, variations in blocks, etc to make the map stand out more!

You are allowed to fix up these errors and update this thread with the new information. 

Overall status:
Aesthetics: 2.5/5
Game-play: 3.5/5
Creativity: 4/5

Thanks for your map submission! :D
